transcript: Job ticket for Greg Kowalski, 401 Chestnut Street. Upgraded the old mechanical dial thermostat to an Ecobee smart thermostat. The old bundle didn't have a C-wire, so we fished new eighteen five thermostat cable from the basement furnace board. Pulled fifteen feet... no, had to go around ducting, so make it twenty-five feet of 18/5 thermostat wire. Customer supplied their own Ecobee unit, so don't charge for the thermostat itself, just our standard thermostat installation service fee of seventy-five dollars from the rate sheet, plus an hour and a half labor.

expected.job_summary: Installed customer-provided smart thermostat and ran new C-wire
expected.notes: Customer supplied Ecobee; ran 25ft 18/5 wire from basement.
